fact: Libya Post says it has been applying a postal addressing project for some time as an integrated system covering all of Libya, giving every part of the country a postal address, with building plates installed in municipalities (first phase 42,000 buildings, over 23 municipalities targeted) and the addresses searchable by Libyan postal code on a map.
title: مشروع العنونة البريدية نظام عنونة متكامل يساعد على سرعة الاستعلام والاستدلال والتحكم ويغطي كامل ليبيا
